description.value: A media representation of the target resource of a reference or canonical.

purpose.value: There are some situations where the system does not have (and cannot have) a formal resource representation of a concept, but do have a media representation such as a scanned fax, an audio clip, etc. This allows referring to that media structure.

short.value: Media representation of the target of the reference

definition.value: A media representation of the target resource of a reference or canonical.

comment.value: It is better practice to have an actual resource with the minimum discrete data present. The media can be referenced in that resource's narrative. However, not all systems will be able (technically or by policy) to create such a resource instance. This extension provides a solution in those circumstances.

requirements.value: There are some situations where the system does not have (and cannot have) a formal resource representation of a concept, but do have a media representation such as a scanned fax, an audio clip, etc. This allows referring to that media structure.
